# PayPal

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 4 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Payments marketing and signed-out login chrome: warm canvas, white and navy and cyan plates, black pill buttons, PayPal Pro headlines, and a separate login card with a blue Next button.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (marketing pages and the login email step were measured; nothing was typed or submitted; the signup wall was recorded and not entered). Themes: light.

Public marketing pages and the signed-out login chrome of paypal.com, read on 2026-11-19. Surfaces: `/` (redirected to `/sg/home`), `/us/home`, `/signin`, and `/us/webapps/mpp/account-selection`. Signed out. Light only. Viewport was the preview pane at 1169 by 731 CSS pixels, devicePixelRatio 2. No account was created. Nothing was typed into the login field. The signup flow after Get Started was not entered.

## Typography

9 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: PayPal Pro, PayPal Pro Text VF, pp-open-medium, pp-open-regular.

### Fonts (from README.md)

PayPal Pro and PayPal Pro Text VF are PayPal's faces, served from paypalobjects.com as woff2. The tokens name them and fall back to Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif. The files are not in this package.

The login page uses `pp-open-regular` and `pp-open-medium`, falling back to Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif. The cookie accept button computed `PayPalOpen-Medium`. Those files are not here either.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Headline sizes are fluid. The px values are what the browser computed at innerWidth 1169, not a 1440 layout. Paragraph 16.647px and headline 60.328px were rounded to three decimals in the tokens.

The secondary button's inset shadow computed as `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)`, so it is not a token. The login card background also computed transparent; the white page is the html background behind it.

`color-scheme` was `normal`. There is no dark set. Declared hover colours in helpers.css (`#333333`, `#0070e0`) were not confirmed on a hovered element, so they are not tokens.

No screenshot backs these numbers. A later capture with frames should replace the empty screenshots folder.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the measured ink, navy, and cyan.** Body text is `light.color.ink` on `light.color.page`. The navy plate is `light.color.navy` with `light.color.on-navy`. The cyan plate is `light.color.cyan`. Readings are in [raw/measurements.md](raw/measurements.md).
- **Use the black pill for a marketing primary action.** 48px tall, radius `core.radius.pill`, label weight 700. The login Next button is a different blue, `light.color.login-action`, radius `core.radius.login-pill`.
- **Keep the login field empty in any reconstruction of this capture.** The email control was measured blank. No address was entered.
- **Stop at the signup wall.** Account selection is the last public step this capture entered. Do not invent the `/welcome/signup` form.
- **Do not invent a dark theme.** These pages painted light only.
- **Do not treat the 1169px headline sizes as a desktop token for every width.** They are the fluid computed size at this viewport.
